correctness.rationale: Uniform second-order Taylor expansion of the exact Brownian erfc density kernel yields the two simple positive roots of a^2-3a+3/4; the previously published strict crossing bracket squeezes the cumulative crossing to the third universal limit. All perturbations are bounded and mean zero.

limitations: Diffusivity is quenched and bounded away from zero for each sufficiently small perturbation.
This scientific revision does not itself certify publication priority or constitute expert attestation.

originality.rationale: The global one-CDF/two-density crossing classification and bracket are prior results, not new. The surviving result is the triple universal weak-disorder crossing-position law, which was not identified in the inspected complete prior theorem or primary full text; priority remains qualified.
residual_risks: Other perturbative first-passage comparisons may contain the three limiting constants under alternate notation.

value.rationale: Natural quantitative weak-heterogeneity benchmark: the three universal time scales and limiting CDF identify where deadline advantage and density advantage change sign; these exact constants are not supplied by the established root-count theorem.
